headline: US futures trade mixed as Nasdaq 100 rebounds from tech-led rout ahead of October jobs report and global AI-regulation worries
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) are up 0.35%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) are down 0.72%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) are up 1.53%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) are up 0.09% in early trade.
- AMD (AMD) rises about 8% pre-market as Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) rebound from yesterday’s heavy tech selloff tied to potential tighter AI and data-center regulations after the midterms.
- Estee Lauder (EL) declines about 0.8% pre-market after raising full-year sales and profit guidance on resilient premium demand.
- Rivian (RIVN) adds roughly 0.4% in pre-market trading after UBS (UBS) upgraded the stock to Buy.
- Check Point Software (CHKP) is roughly flat pre-market after issuing a weaker-than-expected Q4 revenue outlook.
- Moderna (MRNA), Humana (HUM), Vistra (VST), Brookfield Asset Management (BAM), and Charter Communications (CHTR) are scheduled to report earnings before the bell.
- The October employment situation report, including nonfarm payrolls, the unemployment rate, and average hourly earnings, is due at 8:30 AM ET and is expected to drive significant intraday volatility.
- Japan’s Nikkei (@NKD) fell nearly 6% and South Korea’s Kospi dropped over 8%, triggering a circuit breaker and brief trading halts, as the tech-led selloff spread across Asia and into weaker European trade, while oil (@CL) prices fell about 1.5%, gold (@GC) edged lower, and global equity funds saw another week of inflows.
